insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Dormeo Canada grew total sales to $58,388 in Week 46, up 24.3% from $46,985 the prior week, on 115 units. Organic sales led the gain at $17,195 (+229.8% WoW), and the Full Octaspring Topper doubled to $10,500 (+100.0%) as units rose 100.0% to 20. The Queen Topper remained the anchor at $29,362 (+23.4%) on 54 units with a 5.8% conversion rate, and Tuesday, Nov 10 was the peak day at $10,776.

**Metrics to Watch —** PPC revenue eased slightly to $41,192 (-1.4%) even as ad spend rose to $5,823 (prior $3,854), so this week's growth came mainly from organic demand rather than ads. The Twin Topper slipped to $1,572 (-19.4%) on 4 units with sessions down 10.6% to 412, while the Twin XL held steady at $3,192 (+0.0%) on 8 units. We are focusing ad budget on the sizes that are converting to lift paid revenue back above last week's $41,771.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ads continued to deliver solid returns with a 14.1% ACOS on $5,823 of spend, a 0.53% ad CTR and 2.10% ad conversion. ROAS moved to 7.07x from 10.84x and TACoS to 10.0% from 8.20% because spend grew faster than ad-attributed sales, so we are trimming bids on lower-converting terms to bring ROAS back up.

**Actions This Week —** (1) Shift budget toward the Queen Topper (5.8% conversion) and the Full Topper, whose units doubled to 20, to build on that momentum heading into the holiday season. (2) Pause or lower bids on non-converting Twin and Twin XL search terms, targeting ROAS back toward 10.84x. (3) Test new Sponsored Brands ad creative to push ad CTR above 0.53%.
